relationship_to_parallel_work.donor_finding: P1 concurrency and P4 admission are currently proven by disjoint process cohorts.
relationship_to_parallel_work.nonduplicate_extension: This delta derives a stronger protocol-level result: with the current EXACT_SNAPSHOT_ONLY admission rule and one epoch advance per successful coordinator commit, direct same-snapshot fan-in of more than one concurrent cohort packet cannot succeed by repeated per-packet coordinator_commit calls. The splice is therefore not merely an incidental harness choice; it avoids a structural incompatibility that must be resolved explicitly.

source_observations.finding: concurrent_probe emits ten packets from one shared read-only snapshot, but run() deliberately does not admit those packets after coordinator lease creation; P4 instead calls spawn_one sequentially and obtains a fresh packet immediately before each commit.
ExactSnapshotFabric requires packet generation, state_epoch and state_digest to equal the current Fabric snapshot; stale epoch or digest is rejected and implicit rebase is forbidden.
Each successful coordinator_commit sets new_epoch = expected_epoch + 1 and stores that value as the new global epoch.

external_method_support.finding: A read transaction observes a stable snapshot; committed changes from another connection are not visible until the reader ends that transaction and starts another.
SQLite permits multiple simultaneous read transactions but only one simultaneous write transaction; a reader continues to see its historical snapshot until its read transaction ends.

premises: Let cohort packets p1..pN be produced concurrently from one exact snapshot S_k with epoch k and digest d_k.
For admission, ExactSnapshotFabric requires each packet identity to equal the current snapshot identity.
A successful coordinator_commit of p1 advances the global epoch from k to k+1 and changes the covered snapshot identity.
Implicit rebase and relabeling of an old observation as current are forbidden.
derived_result.conclusion: For N > 1, repeated per-packet coordinator_commit cannot directly admit all packets from the original same-snapshot cohort: after the first successful commit, p2..pN carry epoch k/digest d_k while current S1 is k+1/new_digest and must fail stale checks. Therefore a same-cohort integrated GRID10 path needs a different explicit fan-in protocol or narrower acceptance semantics.
derived_result.scope: CURRENT EXACT_SNAPSHOT_ONLY PER_PACKET_COMMIT PROTOCOL ONLY; not a universal distributed-systems impossibility claim.

hypothesis.claim: The intended physical GRID10 semantics require concurrent observations to survive into one coordinator-authorized fan-in object without silently becoming current-state observations after S1 advances.
hypothesis.counterhypothesis: Physical GRID10 acceptance only needs two independent component properties: concurrent read-only physical liveness and separately proven sequential fresh-result admission. If so, same-cohort fan-in is not required and the current split proof can be valid at a deliberately narrower named scope.
hypothesis.decision_needed: Choose and version the intended acceptance contract instead of letting the harness implicitly decide it.

cheapest_high_information_discriminators.test: Attempt to admit two untouched packets from the exact same barrier cohort through the current per-packet ExactSnapshotFabric coordinator_commit path.
cheapest_high_information_discriminators.expected_under_current_semantics: first may succeed if no prior S1 change; second must fail RESULT_STALE_EPOCH or RESULT_STALE_DIGEST after the first commit
cheapest_high_information_discriminators.value: Executable confirmation that same-cohort direct fan-in is structurally incompatible with the current per-packet exact-current rule.

cheapest_high_information_discriminators.test: If integrated GRID10 credit requires same-cohort flow, require one explicitly specified solution: atomic cohort batch commit, immutable cohort evidence plus a separately current derived coordinator summary, or a formally proven provenance-preserving rebase protocol.
cheapest_high_information_discriminators.expected: No packet may have its original observation epoch/digest silently rewritten as current.

cheapest_high_information_discriminators.test: If same-cohort flow is explicitly not required, rename/narrow acceptance and runtime credit so P1 physical concurrency and P4 sequential admission are separate bounded component claims rather than one integrated-path claim.

design_candidates_not_promoted.name: ATOMIC_COHORT_BATCH_COMMIT
design_candidates_not_promoted.idea: Validate all cohort packet digests against one immutable starting snapshot and apply one deterministic coordinator-authorized transaction with one batch provenance identity and one resulting epoch transition.
design_candidates_not_promoted.risk: Must define deterministic ordering/conflict semantics and cannot grant model/canonical/effect authority.

design_candidates_not_promoted.name: IMMUTABLE_OBSERVATION_SET_TO_CURRENT_SUMMARY
design_candidates_not_promoted.idea: Keep all cohort packets permanently bound to S_k, then create a new current coordinator summary whose provenance names the immutable packet set and explicitly reasons about evidence age/currentness.
design_candidates_not_promoted.risk: Summary must not relabel original observations as S_{k+m}; acceptance must distinguish observation validity from current-state equality.

training_eval_reinjection.instruction: Teach temporal provenance and current-vs-historical evidence handling only from deterministic typed outcomes. Do not train the model to self-declare rebase, currentness, batch validity, PID identity or canonical truth.
training_eval_reinjection.hard_negative_concept: Ten concurrent observations from one old snapshot do not become ten current observations merely because a coordinator later accepts a related summary or because logical node IDs are reused.

next_exact_action: Add FANIN-NEG-01 as a deterministic regression against current source, then obtain an explicit supervisor-level choice between same-cohort integrated fan-in and deliberately split component semantics before repinning any physical-GRID10 execution for promotion credit.
